items.title: 'Tale of two Nehas': police detained a lookalike at RK Ashram while the real Neha Bora reached CP
items.summary: On Sunday, AISA president Neha Bora teased on X ('Do I have your attention?... Time & Venue incoming') and announced a 2:30 PM gathering at RK Ashram. Police took into custody there a woman matching her signature look (scarf, black-rimmed glasses, mask) — actually a lookalike; Bora's sister later posted a photo with the lookalike, writing 'The tale of the two Nehas. Not strategy, just coincidence.' Meanwhile the real Bora blockaded Connaught Place ('We have crossed the barricades and reached CP') and was eventually detained at Vijay Chowk. 200+ Sunday protesters were also detained.

items.title: Neha Bora posts video alleging cramped police-bus cells; says women packed in, men 'abused and kicked'
items.summary: After her Sunday detention, AISA president Neha Bora posted a video on X describing the police bus as having four cramped cells with no room to breathe, alleging women were packed into a small compartment and male protesters were abused and kicked. Police have not responded to the claims in the reports available. Background: she had recently ended a 23-day hunger strike at the same spot; by ~2:51 PM Sunday she announced reaching Connaught Place before being taken into custody around 3 PM.
